'''2009 2K Event Day 2 David Lankton LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Lankton]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Not Profit
* '''Username:''' nWoCinematics
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
